_description: SSI (Supplemental Security Income) — monthly cash payments for disabled, blind, or elderly. Eligibility calculated by PolicyEngine.
name: SSI (Supplemental Security Income)
description: Monthly cash payments for people who are 65+, blind, or disabled and have limited income and resources. Covers basic needs like food, clothing, and shelter.
documents_needed: Birth certificate or proof of age
Proof of disability (medical records, doctor statements)
Proof of income and resources (bank statements, pay stubs)
Proof of citizenship or immigration status

application.notes: Apply at your local Social Security office, by phone (1-800-772-1213), or start online at ssa.gov.
